intent.subtype: truncation at an assignment (product wider than target)
intent.rationale: 12-bit sample times 4-bit gain is a 16-bit product assigned to a 12-bit register; the upper 4 bits are lost whenever the product exceeds 4095.

labels.note: 12x4-bit product is truncated to the 12-bit scaled_q.
The 16-bit product sample*gain is truncated to 12 bits on assignment to scaled_q.
